modifications.evidence_text: TSP-PETase containing a C-terminal LPETGG-His6-tag was subjected to Sortase A-mediated ligation with GGGYK-C(Atto647N)-T(amide). No final conjugate amino-acid sequence is inferred.

items.notes: Distinct Atto647N conjugate preparation of biological TSP-PETase. Original accession PB3GMY and complete original actor preserved in provenance. His6 status in final product is not inferred.
items.evidence_location: Methods: Cloning and plasmid constructs; Purification of IsPETase variants for biochemical analysis; Sortase A-tagging of TSP-PETase
items.evidence_text: The dye conjugate produces soluble PET degradation product on amorphous PET film (A260 in the solution-depletion experiment), so the pair is real. The construct is a fluorescent tool used to cross-validate the adsorption measurements, not an engineering target: it is TSP-PETase carrying a sortase-ligated dye peptide at the C terminus. Also used for total internal reflection fluorescence (TIRF) microscopy on spun-coated PET thin films (5000 cm2/L): at 200 pM the mean minimum separation distance between enzyme centres was about 400 nm, individual molecules were indistinguishable by 500 pM, and product formation (A260) was detected on the spun-coated slides. TIRF has no controlled-vocabulary method term, so that measurement is recorded here rather than as an experiment. The paper writes the source organism as Ideonella sakaiensis; NCBI Taxonomy has reclassified that species, and txid1547922's current accepted name is Pseudideonella sakaiensis, which is what is stored.

parent_protein.name: IsPETase
accession_notes: The paper cites no UniProt or GenBank accession for IsPETase. It identifies the enzyme only as IsPETase from Ideonella sakaiensis and cites PDB 6EQE (Austin et al. 2018, reference 24) for the wild-type structure, so sequence is the 6EQE SEQRES record verbatim (298 aa): the 290-residue IsPETase precursor followed by the crystallography construct's C-terminal LEHHHHHH tag.

The construct actually assayed in this paper is IsPETase residues 28-290 (signal peptide omitted, an initiator Met added) with a C-terminal His6 tag, codon-optimised for Escherichia coli and expressed from pET21a+; the full DNA sequences are printed in the Supplementary Methods of mmc1.pdf. The deposited record is stored here rather than the assayed construct, per the verbatim-sequence rule.

original_actor.engineering_method: sortase A-mediated ligation of a fluorescent peptide onto a C-terminal LPETGG tag introduced by site-directed mutagenesis
original_actor.description: TSP-PETase carrying a C-terminal LPETGG sortase recognition tag, onto which the fluorescent peptide GGGYK-C(Atto647N)-T(amide) was ligated by sortase A (about 98% tagged for the Atto647N conjugate). Built as a fluorescent tool for adsorption and single-molecule imaging on PET.
original_actor.performance: Degrades amorphous PET film; the paper cautions that the fluorescent tag may alter adsorption behaviour, and TSP-Atto647N showed the lowest adsorption of the active variants in solution-depletion experiments.
